questions.subject: E
questions.questionText: A vertical pole casts a shadow of length 15 m when the angle of elevation of the sun is 60°. What is the height of the pole?
questions.explanation: tan60° = height/15, height = 15√3 m. "15 m" assumes tan60°=1. "15/√3 m" divides instead of multiplying. "30 m" treats tan60° as 2.

questions.subject: E
questions.questionText:
Consider the following statements about angles of elevation and depression:

(i) The angle of elevation increases as the observer moves closer to the base of a tall object.
(ii) If the sun's elevation is 60°, height to shadow ratio is √3:1.
(iii) Angle of depression from cliff top to a boat equals the elevation angle from the boat to cliff top.
(iv) Of two equal-height objects, the nearer one has a smaller elevation angle.

Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explanation: (i) Correct: closer means larger h/d ratio hence larger angle. (ii) Correct: tan60°=√3. (iii) Correct: alternate interior angles. (iv) Wrong: nearer means LARGER angle. Options with (iv) are wrong.

questions.subject: E
questions.questionText: From the top of a 120 m cliff, depression angles to two cars on the same side of a road are 30° and 60°. What is the distance between the cars?
questions.explanation: Nearer car: 120/tan60°=40√3 m. Farther: 120/tan30°=120√3 m. Gap=80√3 m. "40√3" is only nearer distance. "120√3" is farther distance alone. "60√3" is an incorrect average.

questions.subject: E
questions.questionText:
Given below are two statements, one labeled as Assertion (A) and the other as Reason (R):

Assertion (A): If the shadow of a vertical pole equals its height, the sun's elevation is 45°.
Reason (R): tan45° = 1, so when perpendicular equals base the angle is 45°.
options: Both (A) and (R) are correct and (R) is the correct explanation of (A)
Both (A) and (R) are correct but (R) is NOT the correct explanation of (A)
(A) is correct but (R) is not correct
(A) is not correct but (R) is correct
questions.correctAnswer: Both (A) and (R) are correct and (R) is the correct explanation of (A)
questions.explanation: A correct: shadow=height gives tan=1, angle=45°. R correct: tan45°=1 is standard. R explains A directly. "Both but not explanation" wrong since R is the exact basis. "A correct R wrong" impossible since tan45°=1. "A wrong" impossible since A is valid.

questions.subject: E
questions.questionText:
Match the scenarios in Column I with calculated values in Column II:
Column I:
(a) Elevation 60° from 20 m away from tower base
(b) Elevation 30° from 45√3 m away from pole base
(c) Depression 45° from top of 25 m building
(d) Elevation 45° from 18 m away from tree base
Column II:
(i) 45 m
(ii) 20√3 m
(iii) 25 m
(iv) 18 m
questions.explanation: (a) 20tan60°=20√3=(ii). (b) 45√3×tan30°=45=(i). (c) 25/tan45°=25=(iii). (d) 18tan45°=18=(iv). Other options mismatch calculations.

questions.subject: E
questions.questionText:
Which of the following are correct about a 50 m lighthouse observed from sea level?

(i) Ship at depression 30° is 50√3 m from base.
(ii) Ships at depression 30° and 45° same side are 50(√3-1) m apart.
(iii) Ship moving from depression 30° to 60° has moved 100√3/3 m closer.
(iv) Boat at depression 45° is 25√2 m from base.
questions.explanation: (i) d=50/tan30°=50√3. (ii) 50√3-50=50(√3-1). (iii) 50√3-50√3/3=100√3/3. All correct. (iv) Wrong: at 45° d=50 not 25√2. Options with (iv) wrong.

questions.subject: E
questions.questionText: From a point 30 m from a building's foot, the elevation of the top is 30°. Find the building height.
questions.explanation: h=30×tan30°=30/√3=10√3 m. "30 m" uses tan=1. "30√3 m" uses tan60°. "15√3 m" halves the distance first.

questions.subject: E
questions.questionText: A person on a river bank sees a tree on the opposite bank at elevation 60°. After moving 40 m away from the bank, the elevation becomes 30°. The width of the river is __________.
questions.explanation: Let width=d. h=d√3 and h=(d+40)/√3. So d√3=(d+40)/√3, 3d=d+40, d=20 m. "40 m" is walked distance. "40√3 m" wrongly multiplies. "60 m" adds width and walk.

questions.subject: E
questions.questionText: The elevation angles of a tower top from two points 36 m and 16 m from its base (same side) are complementary. What is the tower height?
questions.explanation: Complementary angles: tanα×tanβ=1. (h/36)(h/16)=1, h²=576, h=24 m. "26 m" averages distances. "20 m" subtracts distances. "28 m" has no valid basis.

questions.subject: E
questions.questionText: A 7 m flagstaff on a tower is observed from a ground point. Elevation to flagstaff top is 45° and to tower top is 30°. Find tower height.
questions.explanation: tan30°=h/d gives d=h√3. tan45°=(h+7)/d gives d=h+7. So h√3=h+7, h(√3-1)=7, h=7/(√3-1)=7(√3+1)/2. "7(√3-1)/2" wrong sign. "7√3" no equation solving. "7/(2√3)" inverted.

questions.subject: E
questions.questionText:
Consider the following statements:

(i) If elevation doubles when distance halves, the original angle must be 30°.
(ii) Elevation from 100 m away is 45° means building is 100 m tall.
(iii) Elevation from 50√3 m to a 50 m building is 30°.
(iv) Moving from 30° to 60° elevation always halves the distance.

Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explanation: (i) Wrong: doubling angle is not same as doubling tangent. (ii) Correct: tan45°=h/100, h=100. (iii) Correct: tanθ=50/(50√3)=1/√3=tan30°. (iv) Wrong: distance ratio is 1/3 not 1/2 (d at 30°=h√3, at 60°=h/√3). Only (ii) and (iii) correct.

questions.subject: E
questions.questionText: A man on a ship deck 14 m above water sees a cliff top at elevation 60° and cliff base at depression 30°. Find cliff height.
questions.explanation: tan30°=14/d, d=14√3. Cliff above deck: 14√3×tan60°=14√3×√3=42. Total=42+14=56 m. "42 m" omits deck height. "28√3 m" is a wrong calculation. "14(1+√3) m" wrongly combines terms.

questions.subject: E
questions.questionText:
Given below are two statements, one labeled as Assertion (A) and the other as Reason (R):

Assertion (A): The sun's elevation angle decreases as shadows become longer.
Reason (R): As the sun approaches the horizon, sin of the elevation angle decreases.
options: Both (A) and (R) are correct and (R) is the correct explanation of (A)
Both (A) and (R) are correct but (R) is NOT the correct explanation of (A)
(A) is correct but (R) is not correct
(A) is not correct but (R) is correct
questions.correctAnswer: Both (A) and (R) are correct but (R) is NOT the correct explanation of (A)
questions.explanation: A correct: longer shadow means smaller tan(angle). R correct: sin decreases as angle decreases. But R does not explain A; the correct explanation involves tangent not sine. Shadow = h/tanθ, not related to sin directly. "R explains A" wrong. "A correct R wrong" impossible. "A wrong" impossible.

questions.subject: E
questions.questionText: Elevation of a flagpole top from 25 m away on level ground is 45°. What is its height?
questions.explanation: tan45°=h/25, h=25 m. "25√2" confuses height with hypotenuse. "25√3" uses tan60°. "12.5 m" halves without reason.

questions.subject: E
questions.questionText:
Match the real-world scenarios in Column I with trigonometric formulas in Column II:
Column I:
(a) Height of hill from distance d at elevation theta
(b) Distance of ship from lighthouse of height h at depression theta
(c) Length of ladder reaching height h at angle theta with ground
(d) Horizontal distance to plane at height h observed at elevation theta
Column II:
(i) distance = h/tan(theta)
(ii) height = d×tan(theta)
(iii) length = h/sin(theta)
(iv) distance = h×cos(theta)/sin(theta)
questions.explanation: (a) h=d×tanθ=(ii). (b) d=h/tanθ=(i). (c) sinθ=h/L so L=h/sinθ=(iii). (d) d=h/tanθ=h×cosθ/sinθ=(iv). Other options mismatch the formulas to scenarios.

questions.subject: E
questions.questionText: Two poles of heights 6 m and 11 m stand 12 m apart on flat ground. Find the distance between their tops.
questions.explanation: Horizontal=12, vertical difference=5. Distance=√(144+25)=√169=13 m. "12 m" ignores height gap. "15 m" uses wrong numbers. "11 m" confuses with pole height.

questions.subject: E
questions.questionText:
A surveyor at P records:
- Tower A (North): elevation 60°, distance 40 m
- Tower B (East): elevation 45°, distance 50 m

What is the difference in heights of the two towers?
questions.explanation: A height=40tan60°=40√3≈69.3 m. B height=50tan45°=50 m. Difference=40√3-50 m. "50-40√3" reverses (gives negative). "40-50√3" swaps multipliers. "40√3+50" adds instead.

questions.subject: E
questions.questionText: From the top of a 75 m tower, a car is seen at depression angle 30°. How far is the car from the tower base?
questions.explanation: d=75/tan30°=75√3 m. "75 m" assumes 45°. "25√3" divides 75 by 3 first. "150 m" doubles height.

questions.subject: E
questions.questionText:
Which of the following are correct calculations?

(i) 40 m tower at 30° elevation: observer is 40√3 m away.
(ii) 20 m pole shadow at 45° sun: shadow is 20 m.
(iii) Points at 30° and 60° to a 30 m tower (same side) are 20√3 m apart.
(iv) Depression 60° to boat 100 m away: cliff is 100√3 m.

questions.subject: E
questions.questionText: A tree breaks in a storm; the broken part bends touching ground at 60° angle, 10 m from the foot. Find original height.
questions.explanation: Standing part=10tan60°=10√3. Broken part=10/cos60°=20. Total=10√3+20=10(√3+2). "10(√3-1)" subtracts. "10(2√3+1)" doubles standing. "30" just triples 10.

questions.subject: E
questions.questionText:
Consider the following statements about a person at the top of a 100 m building:

(i) Depression angle to a car 100 m from base is 45°.
(ii) Object moving from depression 30° to 60° has covered 200√3/3 m.
(iii) Depression angle to an object 100√3 m from base is 30°.
(iv) Objects at depression 30° and 60° on opposite sides are 400√3/3 m apart.

Which of the statements given above are correct?

questions.subject: E
questions.questionText: An observer 1.5 m tall stands 28.5 m from a chimney. Elevation of chimney top from his eyes is 45°. Find chimney height.
questions.explanation: Above eye level: 28.5×tan45°=28.5. Total=28.5+1.5=30 m. "28.5 m" forgets observer height. "27 m" subtracts it. "31.5 m" adds it twice.

questions.subject: E
questions.questionText:
Given below are two statements, one labeled as Assertion (A) and the other as Reason (R):

Assertion (A): If elevation of a tower top is 30° from 60√3 m away, the height is 60 m.
Reason (R): The tangent ratio equals adjacent side divided by opposite side.
options: Both (A) and (R) are correct and (R) is the correct explanation of (A)
(A) is not correct but (R) is correct
(A) is correct but (R) is not correct
Both (A) and (R) are correct but (R) is NOT the correct explanation of (A)
questions.correctAnswer: (A) is correct but (R) is not correct
questions.explanation: A: tan30°=h/(60√3), h=60√3/√3=60 m. Correct. R: WRONG definition. Tangent=opposite/adjacent not adjacent/opposite (that is cotangent). "Both correct, R explains" wrong since R is false. "A wrong, R correct" wrong since A is valid and R is false.

questions.subject: E
questions.questionText: A 6 m lamp post casts a shadow of 2√3 m. What is the sun's elevation angle?
questions.explanation: tanθ=6/(2√3)=3/√3=√3=tan60°. "30°" confuses 1/√3 with √3. "45°" needs equal height and shadow. "90°" gives zero shadow.

questions.subject: E
questions.questionText: From a point 40 m from a tower's base on level ground, the elevation of the top is 60°. The tower height is __________.
questions.explanation: h=40×tan60°=40√3 m. "40/√3" divides instead of multiplying. "20√3" halves distance first. "80/√3" doubles then divides.

questions.subject: E
questions.questionText: From a hilltop, depression angles to two consecutive km-stones due east are 45° and 30°. Find the hill height.
questions.explanation: Let h=height, d=nearer distance. tan45°=h/d, d=h. tan30°=h/(d+1), h+1=h√3, 1=h(√3-1), h=1/(√3-1)=(√3+1)/2 km. "(√3-1)/2" wrong sign. "√3/(√3-1)" wrong numerator. "1/(√3+1)" wrong denominator sign.

questions.subject: E
questions.questionText: An airplane at 3000√3 m height: elevation changes from 60° to 30° in 15 seconds. Find its speed.

questions.subject: E
questions.questionText:
Match the problems in Column I with answers in Column II:
Column I:
(a) Tower height: elevations 30° and 60° from points 50 m apart, same side
(b) River width: tree elevation 60° from bank, 30° from 40 m further back
(c) Ship gap: 100 m lighthouse, depression angles 30° and 45°, same side
(d) Pole height: shadow 10 m, sun elevation 30°
Column II:
(i) 20 m
(ii) 25√3 m
(iii) 100(√3-1) m
(iv) 10/√3 m

questions.subject: E
questions.questionText: From ground level, elevations of the bottom and top of a transmission tower on a 20 m building are 45° and 60°. Find tower height.
questions.explanation: tan45°=20/d, d=20. tan60°=(20+h)/20, 20+h=20√3, h=20(√3-1). "20√3" is total height not tower alone. "20(√3+1)" adds instead of subtracting. "20(√3+1)/2" incorrectly halves.

questions.subject: E
questions.questionText:
Consider the following statements about two equal-height pillars on either side of an 80 m road:

(i) If elevation angles from a point between them are 30° and 60°, it divides the road 3:1.
(ii) The pillar height in (i) is 20√3 m.
(iii) From the midpoint, both elevation angles must be equal.
(iv) If both angles are 45°, each pillar is 40 m tall.

Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explanation: (i) d/√3=(80-d)√3, d=60, ratio 60:20=3:1. (ii) h=60/√3=20√3. (iii) Equal heights at equal distances give equal angles. (iv) h=40tan45°=40. All correct.

questions.subject: E
questions.questionText: A 50 m tall tower and a 30 m tall building stand on a level ground 40 m apart. A taut rope connects the top of the tower to the top of the building. What is the length of the rope in metres?
questions.explanation: Height difference = 50-30 = 20 m. Horizontal = 40 m. Rope = √(40²+20²) = √(1600+400) = √2000 = 20√5 m. "40√2" uses 40 as both legs. "50 m" confuses tower height with rope. "10√29" uses incorrect values in Pythagoras.

questions.subject: E
questions.questionText: Two poles of heights 10 m and 15 m stand 20 m apart. A wire joins their tops. What is the wire length?
questions.explanation: Height difference=5, horizontal=20. Wire=√(400+25)=√425=5√17 m. "20 m" ignores height gap. "25 m" applies wrong triple. "15√2" uses 15 in a 45° triangle incorrectly.

questions.subject: E
questions.questionText:
Consider the following statements about observations from the top of a 150 m tower:

(i) A car at depression angle 30° is 150√3 m from the base.
(ii) A car at depression angle 45° is 150 m from the base.
(iii) A car at depression angle 60° is 50√3 m from the base.
(iv) If a car moves from depression 30° to 45°, it has moved 150(√3-1) m closer.

Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explanation: (i) d=150/tan30°=150√3. Correct. (ii) d=150/tan45°=150. Correct. (iii) d=150/tan60°=150/√3=50√3. Correct. (iv) moved=150√3-150=150(√3-1). Correct. All four are valid calculations.

questions.subject: E
questions.questionText:
Which of the following are true about a 12 m pole's shadow at different sun angles?

(i) At 30° elevation, shadow = 12√3 m.
(ii) At 45° elevation, shadow = 12 m.
(iii) At 60° elevation, shadow = 4√3 m.
(iv) When shadow = 6 m, elevation = tan⁻¹(2).

questions.subject: E
questions.questionText:
Given below are two statements, one labeled as Assertion (A) and the other as Reason (R):

Assertion (A): A person at a building top notes that the depression angle to an approaching car increases over time.
Reason (R): As an object moves closer to a tall structure, horizontal distance decreases while height is constant, making tan of the angle increase.
options: (A) is correct but (R) is not correct
Both (A) and (R) are correct and (R) is the correct explanation of (A)
(A) is not correct but (R) is correct
Both (A) and (R) are correct but (R) is NOT the correct explanation of (A)
questions.correctAnswer: Both (A) and (R) are correct and (R) is the correct explanation of (A)
questions.explanation: A correct: approaching car means steeper angle of depression. R correct: tanθ=h/d; as d decreases, tan increases so θ increases. R directly explains A. "A correct R wrong" is false since R is valid math. "A wrong" is false. "Both but not explanation" is false since R gives the exact reason.

questions.subject: E
questions.questionText:
A surveyor at point P records:
- Tower X (North): elevation 45°, distance 80 m from P
- Tower Y (South): elevation 30°, distance 60√3 m from P
Both towers and P lie on one straight line.

What is the horizontal distance between the tower bases?
questions.explanation: Towers on opposite sides of P: total = 80 + 60√3 m. "80 m" counts only X distance. "60√3 m" counts only Y distance. "140 m" rounds 60√3 to 60 (incorrect since 60√3≈103.9).

questions.subject: E
questions.questionText:
Which of the following are correct about angles of depression from the top of a 45 m building?

(i) Depression angle to a point 45 m from base is 45°.
(ii) Depression angle to a point 15√3 m from base is 60°.
(iii) Depression angle to a point 45√3 m from base is 30°.
(iv) Depression angle to a point 90 m from base is 30°.
questions.explanation: (i) tanθ=45/45=1, θ=45°. Correct. (ii) tanθ=45/(15√3)=45/(15√3)=3/√3=√3, θ=60°. Correct. (iii) tanθ=45/(45√3)=1/√3, θ=30°. Correct. (iv) tanθ=45/90=0.5, θ=tan⁻¹(0.5)≈26.57°≠30°. Wrong. Options with (iv) are wrong.

questions.subject: E
questions.questionText:
Consider the following statements about a helicopter at 200 m height:

(i) Depression to a point 200 m horizontally away is 45°.
(ii) Depression to a point 200√3 m away is 30°.
(iii) If it ascends to 200√3 m and a car is 200 m away horizontally, elevation from car is 60°.
(iv) Slant distance to the point directly below equals 200 m.

Which of the statements given above are correct?
questions.explanation: (i) tan45°=200/200=1. (ii) tan30°=200/(200√3)=1/√3. (iii) tan60°=200√3/200=√3. (iv) Point directly below: slant=vertical=200 m. All correct.

questions.subject: E
questions.questionText: A 4 m statue on a pedestal: elevation to statue top is 60°, to pedestal top is 45° from ground. Find pedestal height.
questions.explanation: tan45°=p/d gives d=p. tan60°=(p+4)/p gives p√3=p+4, 4=p(√3-1), p=4/(√3-1)=4(√3+1)/2=2(√3+1). "4/(√3+1)" wrong denominator. "4√3" no equation solving. "4(√3-1)" confuses denominator with answer.

questions.subject: E
questions.questionText:
Match the shadow problems in Column I with sun elevation angles in Column II:
Column I:
(a) A 10 m pole casts a 10 m shadow
(b) A 5√3 m pole casts a 5 m shadow
(c) A 12 m pole casts a 12√3 m shadow
(d) A 7 m pole casts a 7/√3 m shadow
Column II:
(i) 60°
(ii) 30°
(iii) 45°
(iv) 60°
questions.explanation: (a) tanθ=10/10=1, 45°=(iii). (b) tanθ=5√3/5=√3, 60°=(i). (c) tanθ=12/(12√3)=1/√3, 30°=(ii). (d) tanθ=7/(7/√3)=√3, 60°=(iv). Other options assign wrong angles.
